new.summary_zh: 丹麦欧登塞的Meta数据中心将服务器冷却产生的热量直接输送给附近家庭。服务器运行几乎将所有电力转化为热能，行业估计约90%的电能最终以热量形式散失。这种模式的成功依赖于当地已有的区域供热网络，因为热量远距离传输损耗大，设施必须靠近现有管网。在其他地区，尤其是美国，社区因土地使用、水资源消耗和电网压力对数据中心持反对态度，泰国也有类似担忧。欧登塞的案例展示了数据中心余热造福周边社区的可能性。
new.title: Danish data center is converting server heat into useful household energy
new.snippet:
Data centers usually waste heat, but this Danish firm is taking a different route

When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Data center

A data center operated by Meta in Odense, Denmark is channeling its cooling heat straight into nearby homes.

Server operations typically send almost all of their electricity out as warmth, with one industry estimate placing that figure near 90%. [...] Replicating this setup elsewhere depends heavily on one specific ingredient many cities simply lack entirely — a wide-reaching district-heating network.

Heat cannot travel far without significant loss, meaning facilities must sit close to an existing distribution network.

Odense already had that infrastructure in place before Meta's data center arrived on site, and this is part of the success of the system. [...] This situation stands out against a backdrop of growing resistance to data centers elsewhere, particularly in the United States.

Communities there have pushed back over land use, water consumption and strain on local electricity grids.

Thailand has raised similar objections recently, citing comparable pressure on its own limited resources.

Amid that friction, Odense offers a rare example of data center heat actually benefiting the surrounding community.

Via Science Blog

new.structured_summary: 2026年9月，一项发表于Frontiers的研究分析了2015至2025年间全球高校智慧可持续校园建设趋势。起因是传统校园系统碎片化、缺乏共享可持续发展目标。经过是对荷兰、丹麦、美国和中东等地区在绿色出行、智能停车和车辆管控方面的实践进行比较。结果是提出高校需实现跨部门数据互通与协同运营。该研究虽聚焦校园可持续发展，但其对数据互操作性和智慧校园运营的强调，间接推动教育信息化中数据存储与集成需求，对存储行业在教育领域的应用具有潜在拉动作用。
